data.one_liner: Generate points to draw curved lines on Google Maps.
data.what_it_does: A package to help draw curved lines on Google Maps. It generates a list of LatLng which can be used to render a curved polyline between a start and end LatLng.
use_when: You need to draw a curved route between two points on Google Maps
You want a cost-effective way to display routes without complex routing engines
avoid_when: You need detailed road-following navigation routes
strengths: Simple API to generate curved line coordinates
weaknesses: Limited functionality strictly focused on generating curve points
Not documented for non-Google map packages
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core Google Maps plugin which can render polylines directly if you manage the coordinates yourself.
